translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Ninge Pol, nigr ncdr Timoti, kxnzawz-nrbalqng ne Mevalu Jiszs. Ryrbzkr bamu, nimu leplz kxnztrng ne Gct amrlx kx nzaxvctrpzng mz Mevalu Jiszs. Nimu kcng tzmncng mz taon Filipae, badr kxnzaclvelr nimu x kxnzaclveng dalr makxtr.
Krka'-ngrne kx Gct Trtegu x Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, naokatrlr nimu mz zmrlz ngrdr kxmyalz murde namnc-zpwxamu.
Pol Krka'-ngrde Lr Filipae
Awi-zvz-ngrbo mz Gct rnge mz nzdcpxkr mz drtwrnge nimu.
X mzli kznikeng krka'-ngrne nimu amrlx, krka'-abrtz-zvzx.
Murde okatr-zvzamu ninge mz nzwz-lxblr-krgu mz Nrpakxmrlz, yzuo mzli kc kai tqrlxngiti-ngrnamu, krlzmle mzli ka.
X krlzti-angidrx kx Gct dekc tqayzutrpzle nztekqtr-krde nimu, x sa navz zvz nztekqtr-krde nimu nakrlzbzle mzli kx na-ayrkrpx-ngrdele, mzli kc nayzlu-mou-ngrm Mevalu Jiszs.

Nimu la tqyc zvz mz drtwrnge. X takitrde nzaoti-zvzkr drtwrnge lc nimu amrlx ngrmu. Murde nargu tutr-lxblrpe mz nzwzngr kxmrlz mzli ka tqmncpx-ngrmc mz presin, x mzli kc tqaxplrtr-ngrne Nrpakxmrlz mz nzalvztr-krnge.
Krlz Gct kx trpokiawxu mz nzrpi-krbo kx nzmrlzti-zlwz-krnge nimu vzpxm mz nivz lr Mevalu Jiszs.
X krka'-ngrne nimu, kx nivz lrmu naetunepx zvz, mz nzkrlz-angidr-krmu Gct x nzabrtzlvz-krmu da kxtubq.
X nakrlzamu nzrmcpxngr da kx brngz-esz'ngr, x nzmnc-krmu natubq x natr nakrlzbzle mzli kc Kraes nayzlu-mou-ngrmle.
X krka'-ngrne kx nztubq-krmu lc naetunepx zvz mz nzaxvctr-krbzmu mz Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, murde leplz naglqpxlr Gct.
Nzmnctr-ngrbz Mz Kraes
Mzlengeng x inwengeng, abrtztx-ngrne nzpi-krbo bamu kx kxmule-esz' nzatrkatilr ninge, a' krlc okatrle x axplrle nzwz-krnge mz Nrpakxmrlz.
Murde kxnzaclveng mz ma nyz King kc etu mrka Rom x kzdung kz leplz nzkrlzlr kx mncpxmc mz presin murde wztrpo mz Kraes.
Nzmncpx-krmc lc mz presin, apqtr-mopwzle nabz mzlegung kxnzkqlung. X mzli ka nelzdr br mz nzpipx-krdr Nrpakxmrlz, x trnzmwxlrpeung.
Kxmule-esz' kzdung nidr nzdobulvzlr x sc tzyapwxtipx-ngrdr Nrpakxmrlz mz drtwr kxmwa, a' kzdung nzryapwxpxng murde suti drtwrdr nzokatr-zpwxlr ninge, vzpxm mz nivz lrdr.
X nzkrlzlr kx Gct mcpxle ninge mz nzaxplr-krnge nzwzkr Nrpakxmrlz.
A' ncblo lc-kzng tzyapwxtipxlr Kraes, murde suti drtwrdr namyalzng mz nzamatqkr leplz nidr. X nzrpilr na-aetunepx-zlwzlr nztalvzokr nabznge mzli ka tqmncpx-ngrmc mz presin.

A' sa tqmrlz ye! Murde da kx myapxbz ngi nzvz-zvzkr nzryapwxtipxngr Kraes. Kxmule-esz' nzyapwxtipx mz nabz kxnzpokiangr o mz nabz angidr, a' nzryapwxtipxngr Kraes, dela tqabrtz-ngrne. X abrtz-zvz-ngrne.
Murde krlzx kx sa na-aovxiox mz nzkrka'-krmu ninge, x mz nzokatrkr Mqngr Jiszs Kxnzmcpx.

Da kx pqtx zlwz mz drtwrnge, x da kx obqtipxx, kx bzkq taox mz nzwztr-krbo mz Kraes. A' suti zvz drtwrnge kx nelznge bzkq twz-prlzm, myapxbz mzli ka. Murde na-alex da kx naglqpxngr Kraes, kxmule-esz' mz nzlu-krnge o mz nzbz-krnge.
Murde mz nzmnc-krnge mz nrlc ka, mncbo mz Kraes. A' nzmu nabzx, sa namnc-zvzpebo bade Heven.

Trkrlzwxu myx kxmrlz, nzlungr o nzbzngr. Mncx mz drtwr kxli. Nzmu namnc-zvzbo mz nrkrdrtq, krlzx nzwztr-zvz-krbo mz Kraes. A' suti drtwrnge nzrlaszpx-krnge nzlu-krnge mz nrkrdrtqnge lc, murde namnctrpebo mz Kraes. Murde nzmnctr-ngrbz bade ngi da kx myapx-esz'ngr.
A' krlzx kx sutibe drtwrmu ninge. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, krlz-kzx kx sa nalubex. X sa namnc-zvzbo bamu mz nzokatr-krnge nimu. Murde nzlxngiti-krmu Jiszs x nzabrtzlvz-krmu nide naetunepx.
X nayzlu-mopwc' mzli kc Mevalu Jiszs na-avzpx-ngrmle ninge mz presin, murde na-abrtzlvz-kzamu nzkrlz-krbo nimu.
Tu-amqngiamu Mz Nzotangr

Kxmule-esz' da kx prtz, a' da amrlx kx aleamu natakitrde Nrpa ngr Kraes. Murde kxmule-esz' vzmc mz nzmc-krnge nimu mz mzke', o mncmc rlru, a' naxlrtxpwo nrpa kx tu-amqngiamu mz drtwr kxesz', mz vea ngr Nrpakxmrlz.
Bzkq mwxlrtiamu ncblo kcng tqotaamu badr, murde Nrpakxmrlz aelwapx-ngrde kx Gct sa naodatile nidr, a' na-arlapxle nimu.
Gct rlr-ngrbzle bamu nzwztr-krbzmu mz Kraes murde lxngitiamu nide. X rlr-kz-ngrbzle nzetqtr-krbz drtqmu bade.
Murde mzli ka nzkxpungr kcpwz tqrmctiamu, dekc tqrmcti-zvzx.
